# DevFlow Authoring

Use `AGENTS.md` for startup, `skills/devflow-core/SKILL.md` for lifecycle routing, and the selected owner reference for detailed rules. Preserve Core-exclusive next-step selection, explicit STOP gates, selective learning recall, and Prove before completion.

When changing a host adapter, keep only host capability, owner lookup, fallback or load action, and proof exit. Do not copy lifecycle internals into every entry. Validate with the narrowest relevant package command.
